sources.title: Embassy of Grenada: Visitors
sources.officialityEvidence: Grenada's live embassy visitor page states that rules turn on citizenship and currently links the complete country visa-requirements schedule.

sources.title: Embassy of Grenada: Visa Requirements for Traveling to Grenada
sources.officialityEvidence: The currently linked official embassy nationality schedule is marked Updated April 2024, expressly has a Haiti ordinary-passport row, and defines No Visa Required as no visa needed for entry.

sources.title: Suspension of visa issuance to foreign nationals
sources.officialityEvidence: The current State Department notice implements Presidential Proclamation 10998 from 1 January 2026 and expressly names Haiti in the full suspension.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The Department of State fully suspended visa issuance ... Haiti.

sources.title: 8 U.S.C. 1101: Definitions

sources.officialityEvidence: The official current U.S. Code compilation defines the INA's geographical United States to include Puerto Rico, Guam, the U.S. Virgin Islands, and CNMI.
sources.supportingExcerpt: means the continental United States, Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, Guam, the Virgin Islands ... and the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands

policies.title: Haitian ordinary passports: Grenada visa-free visitor entry
policies.summary: Grenada's currently linked official nationality schedule expressly lists Haiti as no-visa required; its glossary says that this means a visa is not required for entry.
conditions: Applies to a Haitian ordinary passport holder making a short visitor entry; the schedule separately lists special Haitian passports, so this record does not rely on that treatment.
The schedule is marked Updated April 2024 and is actively linked by Grenada's current embassy visitor page; recheck if the embassy replaces the schedule.
Work, residence, study, other purposes, carrier requirements and final admission remain outside this classification.
